entries.subject: DAMIT 3088: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-3088.txt. Model 3088, version 2019-06-24, pole (306°, 52°), period 27.0703 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 87 ±5 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: [Alternative pole and 90 km model.](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/3089) — excluded alternative solution. The package uses the paired 3088 shape and spin and discloses the ambiguity. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 3089: pole (104°, 51°), 27.0703 h, version 2019-06-24, archive diameter 90 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
